印度尼西亚北马鲁古东哈马黑拉县

paras: The Halmahera cuckooshrike or Halmahera cicadabird (Coracina parvula) is a species of bird in the family Campephagidae. It is found in the northern Maluku Islands. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest.
This species was formerly placed in the genus Edolisoma. It was moved to Coracina based on the results of a molecular phylogenetic study published in 2022.
